acceptance_criteria: A drop of the hand count (e.g. 1 to 0) is shown only after it held for 300 ms; a rise is shown at once; a hand lost for single frames never turns the frame orange
The seconds dots are derived from the recording deadline; a late timer callback shows the correct count, and no timer is left after the camera stops
No change to the press guard, the recording time limit or anything the camera stores or sends
goal: The gesture view's hands-seen signal does not flicker, and its seconds dots always match the time actually left.
